mechanism_selected_for_fresh_confirmatio.name: spatial rootedness-composition feedback
mechanism_selected_for_fresh_confirmatio.description: Spatially heterogeneous underground disruption changes the home-locality and home-district composition of the surviving armed underground. Recruitment rewards potential recruits whose local/district identity salience matches that current armed-member rootedness profile. In the known high-mobilization worlds, the resulting decline in recruitable-pool-weighted rootedness congruence dominates the enlarged eligibility pool and lowers mobilization intensity.

claim_boundary: This is post-outcome mechanism selection on a known seed block, not fresh confirmation.
The result identifies an implemented synthetic feedback, not an empirical law of insurgent recruitment.
Fresh support must confirm both the high-vs-low rate contrast and the contribution of the rootedness term before promotion.
next_requirement: Run a new-seed endpoint confirmation with low and high recruitment rates, paired underground disruption, exact logit decomposition, and a frozen-state no-rootedness diagnostic.
